title: READ METADATA privilege support for compliance security profile standards
body:
The [`READ METADATA` privilege](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/access-control/privileges-reference#read-metadata) now supports all compliance security profile standards supported by Databricks and is available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

For a full list of supported compliance standards, see [Compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile).
